messages:
Ivy G.: Morning — quick shoutout to Aaron and Priya for rescuing the all‑hands setup and the sammie situation this morning. You two showed up with chargers, spare adapters, and snacks. Saved the demo and everyone's lunch. Huge thanks 🙏

Aaron: Not a huge thing — saw the chaos, grabbed stuff, sprinted. Glad it helped! :sunglasses:

Priya: Team move. Also Maya rerouted the AV cables like a pro. @Maya you deserve a wizard hat 🪄

Maya: Haha thanks! Happy to play cable whisperer. Also shoutout to Sam who dug the spare HDMI out of lost-and-found — clutch.

Jordan: Confirming — demo went smooth after the rescue ops. Can we make 'sammies and chargers' part of the runbook? :grin:

Lee: I've labeled the kitchen stash container "Rescue Snacks" so future chaos is slightly more organized. Please don't re-label it as a decoy 😅

Sam: Found that HDMI behind the ficus. Nature: 1, chaos: 0. 🌿

Tina: Quick poll idea — mini gratitude board in the kitchen? React with :thumbsup: for yes, :eyes: for maybe. Would be a nice place to drop one-line kudos.

kudos-bot: +1 Aaron, +1 Priya, +1 Maya. Thread pinned to #random for the day. :tada: 

Ivy G.: Love the energy. Adding a tiny callout — whoever brings snacks next sprint gets honorary "Rescue Squad" hat (digital). Thanks again, everyone! :heart:
